title: Overview
text: Ameya Agrawal — Overview Evolving synthesis of everything in the wiki. Updated by wiki-ingest when sources shift the understanding. Who He Is Ameya Agrawal is a strategy leader, social entrepreneur, author, and builder based in Pune, India. He sits at an uncommon intersection: institutional strategy (Strategy Manager / Chief of Staff at MIT World Peace University), social impact at scale (125,000+ people through MGSS, 25,000+ through SkillSlate), active intellectual output (3 Forbes India articles, blog, Medium, book), and hands-on software building (10 GitHub repos). He is an IIM Kozhikode Gold Medalist (2024) and a BE in Electronics & Telecom with Distinction (MIT COE Pune, 2016). He pursued his MBA alongside his wife Vrushali Agrawal, who was in the same cohort. A self-described "shy soul" who loves theatrical performance, he began writing at school age and holds a national record as the youngest engineering student to write a self-motivation book — A Leap Within , published at age 20–21. His decision to decline Harvard and LSE in 2021 in favour of building SkillSlate and leading MGSS is the defining biographical moment — validated by two Presidential National Awards. title: A Leap Within (Book)
text: A Leap Within Overview A Leap Within is Ameya Agrawal's debut self-help book, published by Kalpaz Publication, New Delhi in 2015. Written during his 2nd and 3rd year of engineering, it was completed over approximately 15 months . Available on Amazon and Flipkart. 1 He holds a national record as the youngest engineering student to write a self-motivation book — published at age 20–21. 2 "This book is By the youngster, to the youngsters and for the youngsters." 1 Structure The book is divided into 7 sections covering: 1 1. Life fundamentals 2. Understanding existence 3. Self-exploration 4. Love 5. Societal connection 6. Personality development 7. Practical lessons Includes personal stories, experiences, and motivational one-liners. Sections can be read in any order without losing coherence. 1 Reception 2,000+ copies sold 3 45 ratings on Goodreads 4 Appreciated by Radhakrishnan Pillai (author of Corporate Chanakya ) 1 Readers noted surprise at a 20-year-old tackling complex psychological topics 1 Led to speaking invitations at educational institutions across India 1 Key Quotes from the Book "What is the best thing about people doubting your potential? The pleasure of proving them wrong." 4 "When you are worried about thinking why you can't, you are losing reasons why you should." 4 "Entrepreneurship is a responsibility rather than a profession." 4 "The reason some people put on a mask is not in their blood but it is in their fear that we judge them too soon." 4 "Boss may be one, but leader can be anyone!" 4 "Hard work doesn't guarantee success, dedication and persistence do." 2 Writing Motivation "Writing that one page at a time kept me inspiring." 1 Writing started during school as a way to document feelings and thoughts. His mother preserved a 100-page early manuscript. Engineering was difficult; writing became his hope through it. 1 Goodreads Author page: goodreads.com/author/quotes/13789641.Ameya_Agrawal Followers: 18 www .indiacafe24.com/interviews/authors/get-mot

title: Recurring Themes
text: Ideas & Recurring Themes A synthesis of the ideas that appear consistently across Ameya's writing, work, and public presence. 1. Leadership De-Skilling Senior leaders are losing the ability to make real decisions because systems, AI, and delegation have removed the need for judgment. Ameya calls this a "Judgment Vacuum." 1 2. Patient, Long-Term Leadership The "Farmer Leader" metaphor: great leadership requires planting seeds, accepting delayed gratification, and resisting the pressure for immediate results. 2 3. AI's Threat to Indian Higher Education Ameya argues that traditional college education in India is failing to prepare students for the AI era — 7 specific structural critiques. 2 4. Psychological Roots of Workplace Behavior Inferiority and superiority complexes, loyalty vs. merit confusion, and toxic organizational cultures all stem from deeper psychological wounds — Ameya applies behavioral science to organizational dynamics. 2 5. Social Impact Over Prestige Declining Harvard and LSE to work on SkillSlate and disability rehabilitation signals a deliberate values stance: systemic change over individual credential accumulation. 3 6. Inclusion and Disability Rights Through Mahatma Gandhi Seva Sangh, disability rehabilitation is a core commitment — 100,000+ lives impacted. 3 7. Building Tools You Actually Use His GitHub projects (brain2.0, card2contacts) are solutions to his own problems — personal knowledge management, contact workflow automation. Builder-for-self philosophy. 8. Satire as Commentary LinkedIn posts like "How to ruin your employees completely" use satire to critique toxic management — humor as a vehicle for serious organizational criticism. 4 blog .ameya.page — Post: "Judgment Vacuum: 5 Warning Signs Senior Leaders Are Being De-skilled" (May 1, 2026)  ↩ blog .ameya.page — Posts listed on homepage (Apr–May 2026)  ↩ ↩ ↩ ameya .page — Bio section describing Harvard/LSE decision and SkillSlate/MGSS work  &#
